summary: The Network Information Center explains why it favors standard host names and what a good scheme should do. It suggests names made of a site part and a host part separated by a delimiter, easy to remember, and at least eight characters long. It was replaced by RFC 273.

eli5.summary: The information office says it wants everyone to use one naming style for computers and lists the things a good naming system needs. It later gave a new plan.

questions: host naming scheme site and host
